title: razumovia grandiflora
intro: Razumovia grandiflora, commonly known as the "Angel's Trumpet", is a flowering plant native to South America and known for its showy, trumpet-shaped flowers. The health benefits of Razumovia grandiflora include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids like scopolamine, hyoscyamine, and hyoscyamus, that exhibit sedative, antispasmodic, and anticholinergic effects. These bioactive constituents also contribute to the plant's use in traditional medicine for its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
